facts.fact: NOSi's 2026 plan forecasts CVE 333,345,000 of revenue from state service protocols (the December 2021 protocol with the digital ministry), unchanged from 2025; the plan also quotes the ministry's own 2026 appropriation as CVE 174,200,533.
facts.system: NOSi E.P.E. protocolo com o Estado 2026

facts.fact: The plan's comparison table gives the digital ministry's appropriation as CVE 369,781,930 in 2025 and CVE 174,200,533 in 2026, a fall (and CVE 1,390,965,632 in 2024).

systems.country_label: Nucleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informacao

note: Projetos Financiados (CVE 111,581,000 in 2026, down from 234,465,000) is donor-funded and gives no fact; NOSi's trading revenue is its own and is not a budget line.
